# Purpose

This policy defines how Acme grants, reviews, and removes access to
production systems and company data.

It applies to all employees, contractors, and service accounts.

# Multi-factor Authentication

MFA is required on all production accounts, including administrator and
break-glass accounts.

Hardware security keys are required for members of the infrastructure
team.

# Access Reviews

Access to production systems is reviewed every quarter by the system
owner.

Accounts of departed staff are disabled within one business day of their
last working day.
